easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm
description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Gigantoplasm's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.
